title: fix(app-shell): inspector literals with an existing catalogue row read it (objectui#10696)
body:
Fixes #10696

Clause-②: no

A zh-CN author read `Search fields…` in the dashboard widget inspector's filter-binding field picker, while the designer catalogue already carried `engine.form.searchFields` in en and zh and `DatasetDefaultInspector` read it for the same combo. That site now reads the row. The census the triage asked for found seven more inspector sites passing an English literal where an `engine.*` row with the same English already existed; each now reads its row. No catalogue row is added or changed, so the objectui#4662 `engine.*` carve-out does not move, and en-US renders the same words as before.

This branch resumes the work a previous `os-dev` left at `68eedfed1` (release note `5851632349`); nothing it did was taken as verified. Round 2 (`7e724988e3`) adds the site the contract review of `68eedfed1` found missed: the flow node inspector's nested-node breadcrumb.

## Premise check — H1, measured under zh-CN

Base `383a34f52` (the branch point), pin from this branch: `DashboardWidgetInspector`'s filter-binding combo search box rendered the English literal under zh-CN — `Expected: "搜索字段…"`, `Received: "Search fields…"`. The lit control on the same base, `DatasetDefaultInspector`'s dimension-field combo, rendered `搜索字段…` (its case passed on base). H1 holds as the card stated it.

## Census — H3, over `metadata-admin/inspectors/*.ts` and `*.tsx` (44 source files: the 27 components and the 17 helpers whose strings they render)

Method: an AST walk (TypeScript compiler API) over every JSX attribute value (direct, or inside a ternary / template / binary expression), every JSX text and expression child, and every object-literal text prop (`label`, `placeholder`, `title`, `aria-label`, `emptyText`, `message`, `help`, and the like), plus a broad pass over every string literal in those files so a word that flows into a label through a variable or a helper's return is seen too; class-name-shaped and key-shaped strings dropped. Each surviving literal was compared byte-for-byte against the EN values of `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. Both passes ran on the base tree and on this head. Counts: the default pass keeps 289 of 1282 candidate literals on base and 283 of 1276 on head; the broad pass keeps 1989 of 3821 on base and 1982 of 3814 on head. The rows that disappear between base and head are the seven literals fixed at `68eedfed1`. The eighth site is different in kind: `flow-nested-selection.ts` `regionLabelOf` still returns the English `Try` / `Catch` / `Branch N` (it is the pure, i18n-free mirror of the canvas layout's own fallbacks, and its test pins that), so the census still lists those literals on head with their same-value rows — what changed is their reader, which now translates them at render. The first round's census walked `*.tsx` only and missed that helper; the review of `68eedfed1` found it. Sites are cited by file and enclosing symbol or prop, not by line, per AGENTS.md #11 (a pull-request body has no same file).

### Not words, or another channel — left literal, as PR objectui#10678 and PR objectui#10651 ruled for this family

- Code samples and syntax hints in `placeholder`s: `record.amount * 0.2`, `record.status != 'draft'`, the arrow-function samples in the hook and action script boxes, `comma,separated,values`, the reference-syntax hint in `FlowObjectListField` (`current.FIELD · trigger.FIELD · vars.NODE.KEY`), `/api/v1/…`, `{ }`, `building` (an icon name), the CEL samples in `flow-node-config.ts`.
- Sample values: `status`, `done` (its byte match with `engine.flowSim.status.done` is a coincidence — that row names a simulator status, this is a sample value in a field), `100`, `0`, `255`, `10`.
- Stored values and type names rendered as code, or compared rather than shown: HTTP methods, `script`, currency codes (`USD ($)` …), the scope roots `previous` / `previous.FIELD`, `columns[N]`, the operator names in `datasetFilterCondition.ts` (`equals` is a stored operator, not a label), the type tokens `string` / `number` / `boolean` / `expression` / `true` the helpers compare against.
- `flow-node-config.ts` field labels, help and option labels (`Trigger`, `Object`, `Record created`, `Cron schedule` …): translated at render through `localizeField` from `FLOW_FIELD_ZH` — a different channel, not this card's class.
- `ViewVariantInspector`'s `TYPE_LABELS` map: read only after `t('engine.inspector.view.type.' + type)` echoes the key back, i.e. for a view type the catalogue lacks — a fallback behind the row, not a literal passed where a row exists.
- `DashboardDefaultInspector`'s `New widget` / `New TYPE`: the default title written into the draft — author data, not chrome (the objectui#10678 boundary).

## Round 2 — the nested-node breadcrumb (`7e724988e3`)

The review of `68eedfed1` (PR comment `5852290145`) found that `flow-nested-selection.ts` `regionLabelOf` returns `Try`, `Catch` and `Branch N`, `locateFlowNode` stores it as `regionLabel`, and `FlowNodeInspector` renders it in the `aria-label="nested node location"` crumb, while `engine.flowRegion.try` / `.catch` / `.branchN` exist with the same English and the canvas region header already reads them — so a zh-CN author saw `尝试` on the canvas and `Try` in the inspector.

**Shape chosen: carry the region key out of `locateFlowNode` and translate at the render site.** `NodeLocation` gains `regionKey` (the key `branch-N` carries the branch index), set beside the unchanged English `regionLabel`; `FlowNodeInspector` renders `displayRegionLabel({ key, label }, locale)` with the `locale` it already holds. The pure codec stays English and i18n-free (its own test pins that it mirrors the canvas layout's fallbacks), and the translation happens once, where the locale is. Threading a locale into the helper would have made every `locateFlowNode` caller locale-aware and duplicated the canvas's mapping in the codec.

**Reused `displayRegionLabel` itself, no cycle.** It was a module-private function of `previews/flow-region-view.tsx`; it moved, with its body unchanged (the signature gains `export` and takes `Pick` of `key` and `label`), into `previews/flow-region-label.ts`, a leaf module whose only runtime import is `../i18n.js` (the `LabeledRegion` import is type-only). `FlowRegionView` and `FlowNodeInspector` both import it, so the mapping is stated once and the canvas header and the crumb read one word. A leaf `.ts` module rather than an `export` from the component `.tsx`, so no `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning is added; the parameter is `Pick` of `key` and `label`, so both callers fit. `Body` has no same-concept row and passes through, as does an authored branch name (the function's existing `Branch N` gate); en output is byte-identical (the en rows are the literals).

Round-2 name-status against `68eedfed1`: M `.changeset/10696-inspector-literals-read-existing-keys.md` · M `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx` · M `inspectors/flow-nested-selection.test.ts` · M `inspectors/flow-nested-selection.ts` · M `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10696.test.tsx` · A `previews/flow-region-label.ts` · M `previews/flow-region-view.tsx`. ## Pins — red on base, green on head, per-site ablation

`inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10696.test.tsx`, 22 cases: one zh case per fixed site reading the rendered attribute or text (the open combo's search box, a button's `aria-label`, an input's `placeholder`, the select trigger's text, the crumb's region segment) against the catalogue's zh row behind a guard (not the echoed key, not the en row); an en case per site; and a lit control on the same mount, already translated before this change (`DatasetDefaultInspector` for the card's own control; the nested-id hint for the breadcrumb). The breadcrumb block's outside control is the existing en crumb test in `FlowNodeInspector.test.tsx` (`opens a nested node with a container › region › node breadcrumb and its config fields`), unchanged and green.

- Head `7e724988e3`: the pin, `FlowNodeInspector.test.tsx`, `flow-nested-selection.test.ts`, `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`, `flow-canvas-layout.test.ts` and `flow-region-metrics.test.ts` together: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 99 passed (99)`, exit 0 (the pin's 22 among them). Round 1 head `68eedfed1`: `Tests 17 passed (17)`.
- Base leg, round 2 — the six inspector-side sources (`DashboardWidgetInspector`, `FlowEdgeInspector`, `ObjectFieldInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `FlowNodeInspector`, `flow-nested-selection.ts`) from `383a34f52`, pin from head: `Tests 10 failed | 12 passed (22)`, exit 1 — the ten failures are the seven zh cases of round 1 (`Received: "Search fields…"`, `"Search objects…"`, `"Remove region"`, `"value"` twice, `"— Custom —"`, `"Branch 1 · record.amount > 100"`) plus the three zh crumb cases (`Received: "Try"`, `"Catch"`, `"Branch 2"`); the en cases and the lit controls pass. Restore proven: each path's `git hash-object` equals its HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is 0 lines. Round 1's base leg (four sources) read `Tests 7 failed | 10 passed (17)`.
- Per-site ablation, with objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (one anchor declared to hit once; the write and the restore judged by blob hash on disk): each of the eight sites with its literal put back alone fails exactly its own zh case(s) and restores to the HEAD blob. Round 1, S1–S7: `1 failed | 16 passed (17)` each — S1 `searchFields`; S2 `searchObjects` (mutated inside `ViewObjectPicker`, so the passed prop is ignored); S3 `removeNamed`; S4 lookup `valuePlaceholder` (the summary case stays green); S5 summary `valuePlaceholder` (the lookup case stays green); S6 `branchCustom` (anchor lengthened to the decision-branch block, since the approval-branch picker carries the same row); S7 `branchN`. Round 2, S8 — the crumb back to `{loc?.regionLabel}`: `Tests 3 failed | 19 passed (22)`, exactly the three zh crumb cases (try, catch, unnamed branch); the en crumb case, the lit control and the other 17 stay green.
- Two no-op attempts in round 1, recorded rather than hidden: the driver's first call ran the tool from outside the repository (refused before writing; hashes unchanged), and the first S2 reinstated the wrong text at the caller (`ReferenceError`, so zh and en fell over together — a broken-harness shape, not a reading). Both were redone; the readings above are from the redone legs.

## Published prose — H5

Pending changesets that name these strings: `10586-inspector-strings-i18n.md` (PR 1 of the family: "plus the existing `engine.form.add` and `engine.form.searchFields`… The dataset inspector reads the `locale` its host already passes") and `10586-inspector-strings-i18n-2.md` (PR 2: the combo's defaults, "A label the caller passes still wins"). Neither sentence is falsified: this change adds callers that pass a translated label, which is exactly the case both describe. No dated note is needed and no frontmatter moved. This PR's own changeset now titles eight words and carries a bullet for the breadcrumb naming the canvas header as the rows' existing reader.

## Serial

Not merged.

## Acceptance notes

- The seat's list above (widget-type labels, `InspectorEmpty` messages, `Widget N`, the lookup operator labels, ` · default`, the nested-location `aria-label`, `Must be a JSON object`, `VariableTextInput`'s three labels, the `Body` region crumb, `useFlowScope`'s group headings, `expression-validate`'s client messages) needs new rows, which this card forbids; it is the family's remaining English under zh, read from source with the pin's harness as the instrument.
- `ViewVariantInspector`'s `ViewObjectPicker` takes `searchPlaceholder` as a required prop rather than reading `useMetadataLocale()` itself, because its host already carries `locale` — the `locale` prop channel PR objectui#10678 named for hosted inspectors.
- `flow-region-view.tsx` loses its private `displayRegionLabel` and imports the moved one; its behaviour is unchanged and `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`, `flow-canvas-layout.test.ts` and `flow-region-metrics.test.ts` ran green.
